Metadata.title: TechToJob — A Tech Community for Talent and Companies
Metadata.description: Connect with tech talent, discover opportunities, build projects and prove your skills in a community built to grow together.

Hero.headline: Be known before the job even opens.
Hero.subheadline: TechToJob is the developer and company community where you're known for what you do, not just what's on your CV.

steps.title: Join
steps.description: Join the Discord, introduce yourself, and meet other tech professionals. No endless forms.

steps.title: Show what you can do
steps.description: Take part in real projects and challenges to build experience you can actually showcase.

steps.title: Find opportunities
steps.description: Connect with companies in the community and open new doors for your career.

Talent.headline: Your portfolio is your introduction
Talent.description: You don't need years of experience to prove your potential. Build, participate and make your skills visible.
bullets: Build real projects for your portfolio
Take part in tournaments and skill-based challenges
Connect directly with companies and other tech professionals
No automated filters screening out your profile before a person reads it, and no cost

Company.headline: Know the professional before you hire
Company.description: Discover professionals through what they build, how they work and how they solve problems. Post opportunities and connect with tech talent.
bullets: Discover talent through projects and challenges
Connect with tech professionals from the community
Post opportunities and find relevant candidates

Tournaments.headline: Compete. Build. Stand out.
Tournaments.description: Real-world challenges to prove your skills, learn from others and turn your work into meaningful experience. This very site came out of a tournament like this: what you win actually gets used.

steps.title: Challenge
steps.description: Get a clear brief and solve a real problem with your own approach.
steps.gain: Learn by building with a real case

steps.title: Submit
steps.description: Build your solution and submit your work within the given deadline.

steps.title: Judging
steps.description: Your project is evaluated by a jury using clear and transparent criteria.

Networking.headline: This is where you hear it first
Networking.description: Ask questions, learn from experienced professionals, and hear about good opportunities before they're a public listing.
channelDescriptions: Results, discussions and feedback from every tournament
